notes.title: Patch 2447: Guns, Germs and Acquisitions
notes.notes:
Dear fellow gamers, today we have a huge and important announcement to make.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YEkoCFJ.jpg[/img]
[b]A new kind of sword-fighting[/b]

It's been a humbling five years with Puny Human and with players in our community. We've learned so much, and grew together to form a tight crew. In the wake of the Facebook acquisition of Oculus, we thought to ourselves, what is natural next step in our own evolution?

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3RsUebG.gif[/img]
[b]New attacks for Pure[/b]

Today, we are officially announcing [b]our new partner and sponsor Myspace.com[/b]. We've always felt that sword fighting and indie band social network space mesh well together, like peanut butter and jelly. The acquisition went something like this:

[b]Puny Human:[/b] "So we got this tactical sword-fighting game"
[b]Myspace Tom:[/b] "I don't see any guns in it."
[b]Puny Human:[/b] "Well.. it's a sword-fighting game."
[b]Myspace Tom:[/b] "It really needs a gun. Something loud. Kids these days like Counter-Strike don't they?"
[b]Puny Human[/b]: "I'm not sure Tom.."
[b]Puny Human 2:[/b] "YES WE HAVE GUNS"

To mark this special occasion, we are adding an ultra exclusive Arctic Warfare rifle.

[b]New Weapon[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eYkFniB.gif[/img]
This weapon is a slow-firing, one shot kill weapon, designed for beginners to the game. Our game balance team decided to make it cost a lot of notes in order to balance the game around this new weapon type. You can find it in the customization menu and unlock it by earning notes or using the like button to share the game with your social network. In the future, notes will be deprecated and replaced with likes and you will need to sign into Myspace to continue recording your stats.

 
[b]Patch Notes 2447[/b]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added a new weapon type: Guns
	[*]New weapon: Arctic Rifle, can be purchased for notes or likes on Myspace
	[*]One-shot kill type weapon with a slow reload
[/list]
[b]Combat[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SkeUIZ1.gif[/img]

A lot of changes have been made to reduce the effects of juggling in this patch. Part of this goal is to make being hit in the air not such a drag, and make the recovery smoother.
[list]
	[*]Reduced stun time from being hit in the air from 0.5 to 0.4
	[*]applying increasing combo velocity per attack when player is hit in the air
	[*]slightly increased knockback value for players hit in the air
	[*]reduced movement scale for air stun animation
	[*]made air stun movement only apply to first 0.2s of its animation so the rest of the stun is taken over by gravity
[/list]
There was also a lot of feedback from the players for knockdown. One cheesy play was Ryoku heavy left instantly on a downed player to get free damage. This isn't so fun, so we made recovery much much faster.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Ho7uvON.gif[/img]
[list]
	[*]Reduced recovery time from knockdown from 1.0 to 0.4
[/list]
[b]Tracers[/b]
[list]
	[*]Changed tracer parrying so that heavy stance has increased volume for parry detection and fast stance has reduced volume for parry detection, making heavy more likely to get parried and fast stance slightly less so. This change is somewhat experimental, and the effects aren't all that clear, but it's worth a quick try.
[/list]
[b]Jian[/b]
[list]
	[*]Jian's speed bonus no longer activate when the attack is blocked
	[*]Intercept now has a slight warmup time of 0.125s so now it's window is between 0.125 to 0.4 seconds of the click
	[*]Removed blocking from input buffering so that intercept cannot re-trigger via input buffering
[/list]
[b]Pure[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Bhb4hvC.gif[/img]
[list]
	[*]New Balanced String 1 Tier 3 rising attack
	[*]New Balanced String 3 Tier 3 whirlwind attack
	[*]Reduced fast left damage from 20 to 17
	[*]Fixed an issue preventing Air Forward T3 to be unusable
[/list]
[b]Ryoku[/b]
[list]
	[*]Increased knockback for air left and right from 50% to 100%
[/list]
[b]Judgement[/b]
[list]
	[*]Reduced Balanced String 2 Tier 1 damage from 26 to 24
[/list]
[b]Hero Mode[/b]
[list]
	[*]Heroes can no longer be grabbed, interrupted, or knocked down from shurikens, and blocks all shurikens
	[*]Players now spawn nearest to the Hero upon respawning, similar to Private Duels
[/list]
[b]Joystick[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed pitch not working with default config
	[*]Made 180 turn command use the direction that player was rotating with
	[*]New controller button panel and localization
[/list]
[b]Items[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hiYYTep.jpg[/img]
[list]
	[*]New official Kendo Mask for Judgement
[/list]
[b]Improvements & Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
	[*]Slight fixes to animation interpolation
	[*]Fixed an exploit that allowed stance switching to bypass string advancement
	[*]Fixed a camera issue causing ffa_community spectator cameras to look at the floor
	[*]Fixed animations breaking when changing characters while sitting
	[*]Acquired by Myspace
[/list]
[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
	[*]Monastery: improved brushes, fixed texture alignment issues, improved courtyard floor, fixed issues with ambient occlusion lighting on props and characters inside cloister
[/list]

notes.title: The Dapper Patch #2356
notes.notes:
[b]Animations[/b]
[list]
	[*]Intercept animation updated for female
	[*]Improved male shuffle animations (especially shuffle left)
	[*]Block animations now care about stance, specifically if the stance has the player facing to the left or right
	[*]Block animations now react to attacks
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qbgl4RW.gif[/img]
Enough time to take a selfie
[/list]


[b]Movement[/b]
[list]
	[*]Gave jumps a more curved arc so as to not feel so "hit the ceiling" (see below)
	[*]Shuffle and Rolls now have a 0.3s cooldown after Attacking (re feedback on rolls, and shuffles being over-abused post-attack via Inathero, Water, Airlines). This is unaffected by Katana Feint. So don't freak out. [i]You know who you are.[/i]
	[*]Fixed a bug that allowed attack cancels to be used to ignore shuffle cooldown and vice versa (shuffle canceling bug)
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/kX4otZV.png[/img]
Red line is the old jump and blue line is the new jump

A lot of work was put into refining how the jump feels. The problem was that after pushing the jump button, it felt like characters were hitting their peak a bit too quickly, and then basically stopping at the peak (see the red line above). The original intent was to make the jump feel instant, and powerful, but the limited jump height that we have no didn't play very nicely with this. Hence, we've adjusted the curvature so that it takes slightly longer to reach the peak, but the downward slope and overall height (top graph) and distance (second graph) remain the same.


[b]Side Cancels[/b]
[list]
	[*]Adjusted side canceling percentages so they're more apparent. Seriously, how can someone play 500 hours and not have heard of this feature? Maybe we are failures at informing others of this feature? Anyway, see the new tutorial chapter.
	[*]Side canceling for fast changed from 50% to 60% (cancels 10% sooner)
	[*]Side canceling for balanced changed from 35% to 40%
	[*]Side canceling for heavy changed from 10% to 15%
	[*]This means that for most side attacks, they can be canceled into their other side counterpart slightly faster. This should empower all side attacks slightly, hopefully make stringing these moves together more responsive.
[/list]


[b]Judgement[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/OMGyv85.gif[/img] 
You get a buff! You get a buff! Everyone gets a buff!

[list]
	[*]Sped up Judgement balanced 2 t1 to comp for openings against phalanx foil fasts
	[*]Moved Fast S3 T1 (running stab attack) to S3 T2 and swapped back in the old T1 animation (feedback re ... a lot of players, but special thanks to ebunny for the great writeup)
[/list]


[b]Phalanx[/b]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=223765518&searchtext=][img]http://i.imgur.com/viXXycS.gif[/img][/url] 
Gentleman "Mask" by Hydra

[list]
	[*]Air stance now have a bit more turning (re feedback on Phalanx air's current difficulty to use)
	[*]Air stance side attacks now cover more distance overall as it was being pretty useless as an anti-heavy tool, and hopefully more useful (re WhoArts feedback on their uselessness compared to Forward)
	[*]Modified air left so it can't be abused too badly with feint
	[*]Reduced Balanced Strafing attacks (moveable sides) lock time from 1.0 to 0.8 for left, and 1.1 to 0.9 for right
	[*]Reduced Balanced Strafing attacks velocity pinching on the ground slightly and made the pinch happen closer to the end of the attack (re feedback on these moves being clunky)
	[*]Reduced lock time for Heavy Left all tiers so that Phalanx has a better heavy stance shield move (1.0 to 0.8, 1.4 to 0.9, and 1.4 to 1.2 for each tier respectively)
	[*]Increased fast stance knockback very slightly overall to give opponents more breathing room between fast pokes
	[*]Reduced knockback for Fast 4 T1 by a lot, since Phalanx already has the natural bounce-back on the move and movement abilities are no longer usable to deal with catching back up to Phalanx
[/list]


[b]Pure[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pqRaXwb.gif[/img] 
SCIMITAR OP (???)

[list]
	[*]New Pure Fast S1 T3 attack, an instant-start version of T1
	[*]New Pure Fast S2 T3 attack, a vertical attack with a follow-up
	[*]New Pure Fast S3 T3 sliding knock-down attack
	[*]New Pure Balanced S1 T2, which is a long-held version of T1 used as a better tracer parry block
	[*]New Pure Balanced S2 T2, a slower version of T1 dealing damage the whole way through
	[*]New Pure Balanced S3 T2, a slower version of T1 with tracers starting earlier and ending later
	[*]New Pure Balanced Right T2, a slower version of T1 with active tracers nearly the entire animation
	[*]Updated Pure Heavy Stance upper body animation
[/list]


[b]Ryoku[/b]
[list]
	[*]Trimmed air side attacks so they don't linger on the ground
	[*]Added a bit more land-lock time for Ryoku air side attacks (0.75s to 0.9s)
[/list]


[b]Foil[/b]
[list]
	[*]Renamed to Rapier (requested by lots of people who actually use the weapon IRL) (rest of stats, website, etc still needs to be updated)
	[*]Increased parry recovery time for the Parry user on forward attacks from 125% to 130%
	[*]Decreased knock-back on Foil from 25% to 15%
	[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing back+attack to escape the parry recovery penalty
[/list]


[b]Longsword[/b]
[list]
	[*]Forward damage increased from 75% to 80%
[/list]


[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
	[*]Disabled tracer refraction effect when shader settings are on low/med
[/list]


[b]Stats[/b]
[list]
	[*]Leagues now update immediately after duels
[/list]


[b]Workshop[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed unapproved items not showing up on local player
	[*]Fixed a workshop crash when publishing items
	[*]Fixed an issue where masks for Phalanx were not working
	[*]Fixed mask icons in menu not refreshing if item was subscribed while customization screen is open
[/list]


[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
	[*]Community map updates (storage room, rooftops) and fixed some clipping issues
	[*]Fixed camera passing through deck fencing on free_winter
[/list]


[b]Tutorial[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added initial version of Canceling tutorial chapter, covers side canceling, feint canceling, and air canceling.
	[*]Swapped some wording in the tutorial.
[/list]


[b]Bot[/b]
[list]
	[*]AI Practice mode will now randomize the practice opponent's character
	[*]The bot now randomizes stances
	[*]Removed intro camera from Bot practice
[/list]


[b]Other[/b]
[list]
	[*]Updated credits
	[*]Hello reddit
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2276
notes.notes:
The jumping was a bit out of control. This version has greatly reduced jumping (near player-height jumps), so be prepared to have your muscle-memory destroyed.

As always, leave your thoughts on the discussion forums.

[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/judge_fast3.gif[/img]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
	[*]Reduced jump height
	[*]Reduced jump distance
	[*]Slowed down shuffle slightly
	[*]Slightly increased jump delay
	[*]Reduced side canceling for Heavy Stances from 25% of animation to 10% of animation (less canceling). Affects Pure and Judgement since only they can cancel heavy into other heavies.
	[*]Increased recovery time when hit in air from 0.3s to 0.5s
[/list]


[b]Phalanx[/b]
[list]
	[*]No more gliding (Phalanx Air String 1)
	[*]Sped up Air side attacks very slightly to compensate for new telegraphing, adjusted land-lock times accordingly
	[*]Fixed Phalanx Air String 1 landing animation
	[*]Phalanx Balanced Left / Right mobile T1 attacks recover slightly faster (0.2 seconds)
[/list]


[b]Judgement[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed Judgement Balanced S1 T1 so initial tracers are usable (and increased locktime very slightly)
	[*]Reduced length of tracer for Judge Heavy Left / Right Tier 1
	[*]Replaced Fast S3 T1 with a double stab running move (glap closing tool)
[/list]

[b]Pure[/b]
[list]
	[*]Sped up Fast Left T1
	[*]Sped up Balanced Right T1
	[*]Sped up Balanced S3 T1
[/list]


[b]Foil[/b]
[list]
	[*]Reduced Guard tracer width from 15 to 5
[/list]


[b]Hero Mode[/b]
[list]
	[*]Non-heroes only deal 50% damage in hero mode
	[*]T3 attacks now only interrupt Hero
	[*]T1-T2 attacks do not stun or interrupt the hero at all
[/list]


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
	[*]made sm30 only shaders fall back to wireframe if unsupported
	[*]added lowend command '-lowgpu' which completely prevents allocation and rendering of enw effects
	[*]resources for workshop approval
	[*]Community map models and textures
	[*]Recompiled Community for better fps
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed community missing textures
	[*]Default vsync to false
	[*]Feint effects prediction fixes
[/list]


[b]Workshop[/b]
[list]
	[*]Items now have an "approved" tag, which controls whether or not you will see them in game. To see ALL items regardless of approval go to Settings->Game->Workshop and set Workshop items on other players from Approved to All.
	[*]Workshop items gain approval by having a moderator flag it as approved.
[/list]

[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/workshopapprove.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The AI Motion Blur Mask Feint Patch #2243
notes.notes:
Blade Symphony update #2243
Hey all we have a lot of new updates for you in this patch!


[b]AI Opponent[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/page_01.jpg[/img]

You can now practice with bots under Training->AI Opponent. It's an initial prototype, we'll expand more on the features of the training bot soon.

 


[b]Per Pixel Motion Blur[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/perpixelblur.png[/img]

Biohazard has been working on some graphical improvements to the game. Per pixel motion blur applied onto players make animations look more fluid and dynamic.


[b]Ambient Occlusion[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/ambientocclusion.png[/img]

The new ambient occlusion options (HBAO) allow the levels to 'pop' a bit more by creating shadows between crevices.

 


[b]Workshop Masks[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/masks.png[/img]

Players can now publish and share custom masks. Check them out on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=225600]Steam Workshop[/url]!

 


[b]Leagues[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/leagues.png[/img]

We've revamped how the ladder works. Players are now divided into leagues based on their ELO percentile. Only same league matches are ranked, which prevents farming low level players, as well as shiny new icons you can earn in your stats profile page. We've also taken out the GLICKO time-based system, so you earn points regardless of last time played.

 
General[/b]
[list]
	[*]Workshop now supports masks
	[*]FFA now ranked by default
	[*]Community optimization and detailing: storefronts, landing pad, etc.
	[*]Added leagues Oak, Iron, Steel, Diamond, Master and changed the ranking system
	[*]Players now only gain or lose ranking when dueling within their league
	[*]Scoreboard now shows league instead of rank
[/list]
 
Balance[/b]
[list]
	[*]Removed speed multiplier for dash animation, duration is now derived from animtime
	[*]Increased shuffle animation speed by ~20%
	[*]Made roll move scale 0.8 so that rolls can move up to 5 squares
	[*]Throwing star animation made faster, from 1.2s to 0.9s
	[*]Swapped Ryoku fast string 4 t1 with t2, reduced "new" t1 lock time to 0.4s (from 0.5), gave it knockback 0.8

notes.title: The AI Motion Blur Mask Feint Patch #2243
notes.notes:
Blade Symphony update #2243
Hey all we have a lot of new updates for you in this patch!


[b]AI Opponent[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/page_01.jpg[/img]

You can now practice with bots under Training->AI Opponent. It's an initial prototype, we'll expand more on the features of the training bot soon.

 


[b]Per Pixel Motion Blur[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/perpixelblur.png[/img]

Biohazard has been working on some graphical improvements to the game. Per pixel motion blur applied onto players make animations look more fluid and dynamic.


[b]Ambient Occlusion[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/ambientocclusion.png[/img]

The new ambient occlusion options (HBAO) allow the levels to 'pop' a bit more by creating shadows between crevices.

 


[b]Workshop Masks[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/masks.png[/img]

Players can now publish and share custom masks. Check them out on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=225600]Steam Workshop[/url]!

 


[b]Leagues[/b]
[img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/leagues.png[/img]

We've revamped how the ladder works. Players are now divided into leagues based on their ELO percentile. notes.notes:
Hi everyone, update revision #2071 is live for Blade Symphony. Included are lots of balance changes, spectator music, Ryoku's voice, a sit animation, better controller support and more. Here's the changelog:

 
Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added a new property airspeedscale for attack speed velocity scaling when in the air
	[*]This scaling is applied to the following attacks (all strafing attacks)
[list]
	[*]Judgement: Heavy Left T1, Heavy Right T1
	[*]Phalanx: Balanced Left T1, Balanced Right T1
	[*]Pure: Fast Right T1, Balanced Left T1
[/list]

	[*]Enabled feint in the air
	[*]Re-enabled air stance lock for attacks with landing animations
[list]
	[*]As a result, air stance side attacks are not side-cancelable
[/list]

	[*]Made side cancel for fast from 0.75 to 0.5
	[*]Made side cancel for balanced 0.5 to 0.35
	[*]Changed fatigue settings to what they were before patch 2002 (except for running)
[list]
	[*]bb_fatigue_postattack_duration from 1.1 to 0.5
	[*]bb_fatigue_levels from 3 to 5
[/list]

	[*]Made rolls not as affected by fatigue
	[*]Made getting hit not affect your turn speed
	[*]Fixed tracer intersection preview not working in ffa without private duel
	[*]Added command for Bot sparring in the tutorial menu.
	[*]Rolling sideways now uses the roll forward animation, to the sides
[/list]
 
Graphics & Sound[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added spectator music (Tom Stoffel FTW)
	[*]Added sit action ('meditate'), bind in controls
	[*]Made roll forward versions of left and right

	[*]Changes to Pure, Phalanx, Announcer vox
	[*]Replaced Ryoku vox
	[*]Added announcer toggle to game options

	[*]Pulse shop for community
	[*]Community misc. detail and optimization, skybox
[/list]
 


[b]Scimitar:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Made scimitar multi-hit damage from 7 to 6
[/list]

	[*]Made Blocking (Katana, Scimitar) not turnable

[list]
	[*]Foil guard delay from 0.5s to 0.15s

[list]
	[*]Air left move scale from 0.65 to 0.5
	[*]Air right move scale from 0.75 to 0.6
	[*]Balanced left lock duration from 1.0 to 1.2
	[*]Balanced right lock duration from 1.15 to 1.3
	[*]Fast sides lock duration from 0.35 to 0.5
	[*]Fast side tracers now cover in front of him

	[*]Phalanx S1 T2 lock duration from 0.6 to 0.8 and knockback scale from 1.0 to 1.4 (Dino/Taz)
	[*]Added airspeedscale for Pure fast right t2 (thanks eBunny)
	[*]Adding a bit of locktime to phalanx air forward landing from 0.35 to 0.55
	[*]Updated animation for phalanx air forward
[/list]
Ryoku:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fast side move scale from 1.0 to 0.7 (less movement)
	[*]Fixed fast 2 t1 tracer
	[*]New air left t1, air right t1
	[*]Reduced damage for air left/right t2 attacks from 24 to 18
	[*]Reduced damage for air left/right t3 attacks from 30 to 22
	[*]Changed air right t2 and t3 animations to be same as t1 whirlwind
	[*]Air side now has landing lock-time of 0.75s
	[*]Air right now uses the correct landing animation
[/list]
Pure:[/b]
[list]
	[*]New fast left T2 and fast right T2
	[*]New fast S1 T2
	[*]Fast right T3 now uses T2 animation
[/list]


[b]Judgement:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Reduced velocity pinch for Judgement Heavy Left
[/list]
Joystick support:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed joystick camera overwriting viewangle locking
	[*]Fixed dash/shuffle/directional attacks not being affected by joy movement
	[*]Fixed joystick inversion controls in UI
	[*]Added axis mapping to config_joy_default
	[*]Added 360controller.cfg which is auto executed when joystick is enabled
	[*]Fixed spectator controls for joystick
	[*]Added gameui_toggle command for joystick
	[*]Implemented joy controls in customization screen
	[*]Added joy cmd to turn 180 degrees
	[*]Added main menu button links for joystick
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2002 Changelog
notes.notes:
Full log here: http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/11/blade-symphony-update-2002-changelog/

Hi all - here's the changelog for revision 2002 of Blade Symphony. Included in this patch is a much improved heavy stance for Pure, two new chapters for the tutorial, voices for Phalanx and an announcer, as well as other miscellaneous bug and exploit fixes and balance. Here's the notes: 

[b]General & bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Added chapters 4 and 5 to the tutorial, covering grabs, being knocked down and recovery[*]Made notes on customize screen visible at all times[*]Fixed grab deflect exploit[*]Fixed string counter not resetting when canceling a charged attack[*]Made string counter reset to 0 when reaching end of string (when switching stances)[/list] 
[b]Gameplay & balance:[/b]
[list][*]Added velocity pinching for moveable attacks when the attack is in the air[*]Hit stun for fast attacks reduced from 0.5 seconds to 0.4 seconds[*]Ryoku fast 1 is now a bit faster (0.32 to 0.28) locktime so that it is nearly guaranteed combo to fast 2[*]Pure:[list]New heavy string 2 tier 2 attack[*]New heavy right tier 1, moved old tier 1 to tier 2[*]New heavy left tier 2[/list][*]Phalanx:[list]Re-recorded tracers for fast left and fast right reducing their arcs[*]Re-recorded tracers for balanced left reducing its arc[*]Adjusted velocity pinch for balanced left so it starts in the middle of his animation[*]Adjusted lock duration for fast 2 from 0.35 to 0.4 seconds giving this string a combo break[list]This makes it so that Phalanx cannot combo his entire fast string[/list][/list][*]Foil changes:[list]Forward attack damage from 0.5 to 0.75[list]Note that this doesn't actually buff the foil due to the below changes to foil damage calculation.[/list][*]Heavy attack damage from 0.9 to 0.6[*]Changed Foil thrust calculation to happen earlier so it properly applies damage scaling[list]This makes it so that Foil does better overall damage but less bonus on the dot product.[/list][/list][*]Movement:[list]Buffed jumping a bit (4.5 squares of movement, compared to 3.5)[*]Lowered fatigue max from 2.0 to 1.5 (the fatigue cooldown is 0.5 seconds faster)[*]Attacks now add less fatigue so you can still do pretty good shuffles or dashes after a single attack[*]Fatigue now has less of an effect on running[/list][/list] 
[b]Sound[/b]
[list][*]Added new Phalanx voice-over[*]Added new announcer voice[*]New Foil swing sounds[/list] 
[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list][*]Community: monorail, information screen, new store-fronts added, general detail pass[*]Fixed alignment for pure run upper[*]Pure animation pass[list]turning animations for all her ground stances[*]bowing animation[/list][*]Fixed lower body animation stopping movement when switching stances while doing a movable attack[*]Added Kickstarter textures in district[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1906
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
We have a small update for you, but big news. Blade Symphony is going to be on sale on Steam this week (Monday, October 14th through the end of Sunday, October 20th), and to coincide with this we are also going to be trying to spread the word as much as possible. If you could help us get the word out, we’d really appreciate it! The game is being massively discounted -- [b]50% off[/b]! 

We also just released a patch with a couple of bug fixes and an initial version of our tutorial to try and help the new players on their way towards becoming dueling masters. Along with this patch, we will be wiping the stats that have been collecting up to this point on blade-symphony.com. This means everyone will get a chance to start fresh this week on the [url=http://blade-symphony.com/ladder]ladder[/url] and will be able to quickly find their place in the rankings and see how they stack up against other players. 

[url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/10/blade-symphony-on-sale-on-steam-this-week/bsym_stats_10-14-2013/][img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/10/bsym_stats_10-14-2013-1024x402.png[/img][/url]

Thanks for playing and supporting our game, and be sure to tell your friends they can get [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/225600/]Blade Symphony for 50% off on Steam[/url] this week! Happy dueling! 

Changes in update #1906[list][*]Added tutorial with 3 chapters to explain the basics of gameplay[*]FFA modes are no longer ranked[*]New build of ffa_community with more detail, signage and skybox work[*]Fixed issue where attached items (capes, scabbards, etc.) could have broken textures[/list] 

*edit*

It's now at 50% off, apologies for the confusion.

If you got the game today or yesterday feel free to message me but not on discount. We'll take of you.

[url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/09/blade-symphony-update-1815/]Full Changelog Here[/url]

[url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/09/blade-symphony-update-1815/berimbau-2013-09-22-23-03-25-59/][img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/09/berimbau-2013-09-22-23-03-25-59-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/09/blade-symphony-update-1815/berimbau-2013-09-22-23-04-54-33/][img]http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/09/berimbau-2013-09-22-23-04-54-33-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Changelog for version #1815[/b]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added a new character, [b]Pure[/b]
[list]
	[*]Pure is a female Hotuken assassin
	[*]Her fighting style is based on the Chinese art of Wushu sword fighting
	[*]She has an air attack, 3 fast attacks, 3 balanced attacks, and 2 heavy attacks
[/list]
	[*]Added [b]Hero game mode[/b] to FFA
[list]
	[*]In hero mode, one player is the hero, and the other players are trying to bring him down
	[*]The hero deals more damage, and takes less damage
	[*]The hero will be denoted by his flaming sword
[/list]
	[*]You can now vote to change game mode in FFA via the "Play Online" sub-menu
	[*]Added some knockback to parries
	[*]Movable attacks now have pinched velocity based on when the attack comes out
	[*]Updated and changed timings for judgement heavy left and right to feel faster and made them recover much faster
	[*]Added some stance-aware canceling so that heavy stances aren't so dominated by canceling
	[*]Shortened window for intercept timing
	[*]When being grabbed, pressing grab will now break out of opponent's hold
	[*]Swords:
[list]
	[*]Scimitar now interrupts again
	[*]Made scimitar victims interrupt half the normal amount
	[*]Scimitar now have full knockback again
	[*]Made longswords do 15% more interrupt time
[/list]
	[*]Movement:
[list]
	[*]Lowering the distance moved a bit for rolls
	[*]Replacing dash with roll forward
	[*]Rolling move distance scale from 1.4 to 1.25
[/list]
	[*]Kneeling state:
[list]
	[*]Reduced amount of locktime for kneeling recovery (0.75 -> 0.6)
	[*]Reduced locktime of kneeling attack (1.25 -> 1.0)
	[*]Increased damage for recovery attack (25 -> 30)
	[*]Made kneeling intercept the same intercept as Jian
[/list]
	[*]Ryoku:
[list]
	[*]Updated ryoku air 1 so its much shorter
	[*]Updated ryoku air left and right so they don’t take over gravity as much
	[*]Updated ryoku fast left and right t2 so they travel more
	[*]Removed ryoku balanced 3
[/list]
	[*]Judgement:
[list]
	[*]Slowed down heavy side attacks a bit for judgement
	[*]Added more lock time to heavy side attacks for judgement
[/list]
	[*]Phalanx:
[list]
	[*]Recovery time for phalanx heavy left T1: 1.4->1.2 / T2: 1.8->1.4 / T3: 1.8->1.4
	[*]Recovery time for phalanx heavy right T1: 1.6->1.3 / T2: 1.8->1.3 / T3: 1.8->1.3
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
	[*]Community map updates - Added a bunch of storefronts, an art gallery, garden, storage room updated, misc. detailing
	[*]Walk animations updated
	[*]New Shuffle animations
	[*]New Parry upper body animations
	[*]Stumble animations updated
	[*]Added Ryoku stance icons
	[*]New roll forward and back animations for male and female
	[*]Samurai mask added for Judgement
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
	[*]New Foil heavy swing sounds
	[*]New Katana swing sounds
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed being able to access a ledge in Temple Dojo
	[*]Fixed ragdoll limbs going through glass
	[*]Characters that are dying no longer block collision
	[*]Trees moved in Winter to prevent blocking player’s camera
	[*]Fixed wallrun exploit in Monastery cloister
	[*]Fixed wallrun bug in Monastery library
[/list]

notes.title: Nightly Build Update + Testing
notes.notes:
[url=http://punyhumangames.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=150&t=22298&sid=797a54003953dd0997a34939b2b32c45]Follow these instructions[/url] to try out the nightly changes.

All
+ Shuffles are now the same framerate as a build ago except with the beginning of its animation made much faster
+ You can now grab while being grabbed, to break the hold. This can only be done in the first 0.4s of the animation. Doing so will leave the defender with frame advantage.
+ Made kneeling recover faster when just standing up
+ Made recovery attack stronger and recover faster
+ Made kneeling intercept the same animation as Jian intercept
+ Slightly tuned roll movement scaling (these animations are still WIP)

Phalanx
+ recovery time for phalanx heavy left t1 1.4->1.2 t2 1.8->1.4 t3 1.8->1.4
+ recovery time for phalanx heavy right t1 1.6->1.3 t2 1.8->1.3 t3 1.8->1.3

Pure
+ now has recovery attacks
+ slowed down balanced left and fast right

Judgement
+ slowed down heavy side attacks a bit
+ added more recovery time for heavy side attacks

Jian
+ fixed a bug where it causes players to not die from being hit by it

+ Added game mode settings to vote hud

+ Hero in Hero mode now has a flaming sword

+ Numerous graphical fixes and map fixes I won't list here

Feel free to participate in these tests. Your feedback will be considered for the next revisions as we move towards getting this patch out of the door and into more players.

notes.title: Patch 1665 Change Log
notes.notes:
Hey all, Flux here for your patch notes. I realize that the last patch was controversial. I won't spend too much time discussing it here, except to tell you [i]thank you[/i] for being so extremely patient with us and our experimentation and changes.

I want to organize a new event for game balance purposes called Feedback Friday, where you can hang out with us in-game and I will give you my complete attention. TBD when exactly and where, but the idea is to spare a part of one day a week to hear everyone's concerns, and experiment in-game on various game related things. 

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Made shuffle disregard fatigue but have a cooldown again[*]Shuffle now has a very slight cooldown right before being used again right after attacking. This cooldown is shorter than shuffle to shuffle[*]Disabled Pure from character selection screen[*]Reduced air parry knockback by half[*]Added a materialsrc folder in main Blade Symphony folder for Steamworks developers[/list] 
[b]Balance[/b]
[list][*]Scimitar[list][*]Removed damage so it does flat minimum damage of 8 on all hits[*]Gave scimitar a slight knockback of 0.1[*]Slightly reduced multi-hit rate[/list][*]Judgement[list][*]increased knockback of balanced s1 t1[*]increased startup tracers for balanced right t1[/list][*]Phalanx[list][*]changed tracers on balanced s1 t1 so that it starts up slightly later and doesn't go on for that long[*]changed tracers for fast s3 t1 so it doesn't hit as many times and starts up slightly later[*]changed tracers for fast s4 t1 so it doesn't last very long and starts up later[/list][*]Ryoku[list][*]changed tracers for air s1 t1 so it doesn't hit as many times and starts up a bit later[*]changed tracers for b c1 t1 so it doesn't hit as many times and starts up slightly later[*]changed tracers for b c3 t1 so it doesn't hit as many times and starts up later and ends earlier[/list][/list]
[b][/b]

[b]Maps[/b]
[list][*]Updates to community including more fleshed out areas and models.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1658
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here's the changelog for today's update, version 1658. Highlights include a new fatigue system to try and curb dash spam, workshop integration, and a much sexier Community. As always, there's a bunch of work being done behind the scenes, and Flux has put out a couple of videos demonstrating the progress on Pure, the new female character coming soon to Blade Symphony. You can check out some of her attacks [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWLjtvSY5vE]here[/url] and [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Y0lD_7fUSw]here[/url].

As always you can find our [url=https://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/08/blade-symphony-update-1658-changelog/]patch notes at our website.[/url]

Please note that our official gameplay servers are out of date and still require updating. Sorry about that.

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Steam Workshop integration support: you can now create swords for the steam workshop and upload them via an in-game UI, and Blade Symphony now supports the Steam Workshop.[*]Implemented a fatigue system where the more you perform some actions, the more tired you become and the less effective the action is[list]Slows down rolling, dashing and jumping[*]Slows down movement if high fatigue[*]Fatigue wears off over time[*]HUD stance icon glows red to indicate fatigue level[/list][*]Big update for Community with lots of graphical detail added[*]Fixed client d/c'ing and crashing when connecting to a server with a custom map[*]Changed some vote cvars to be cheats protected so they can't be abused[*]Reduced roll/shuffle movement by 25%[*]Improved disconnection message[*]Reduced hitstop for tracer parries[*]Removed blur from shuffle as it was causing huge framerate loss in certain situations[*]Added a vs_free_setffahealth command that sets the health of everyone who's not in a duel, in free servers[*]Added a ragdoll follow camera mode used when you die[/list] 
[b]Balance[/b]
[list][*]Judgement[list]Fast Left T2 increased lock time from 0.32 to 0.5 and damage reduced from 18 to 16[*]Shortened startup tracers for Fast Left T1 and Fast Left T2[/list][*]Phalanx:[list]Balanced left damage 20 -> 17[*]Balanced right damage 20 -> 18[*]Heavy S1 T1 damage 30 -> 33[*]Heavy left t2 damage 24 -> 25, t3 damage 28 -> 30[*]Heavy right t1 damage 20 -> 25, t2 damage 24 -> 27, t3 damage 28 -> 30[/list][*]Longsword:[list]Air damage multiplier from 0.8 back to 1.0[*]Charge time multiplier 1.4 -> 1.3[*]Charge run multiplier 0.4 -> 0.6[/list][*]Scimitar:[list]Removed knockback and tracer parry turning[*]Can no longer interrupt opponent when attacking[*]Made damage multiply by 25% every multi-hit[*]Reduced multihit rate from 0.032 to 0.034[*]Decreased damage from 30% to 10%[*]Increased minimum multihit damage from 3 to 8[/list][*]Jian: Air damage multiplier 1.5 -> 1.3[/list] 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed config_default being excluded[*]Disabled jumping during airmoves so you can't jump while you're landing[*]Fixed air attacks causing you to float if done very high above ground[*]Fixed dedicated servers and game client running on the same machine, the client can join now[*]Fixed issue with tracer parries not handling their stance powers correctly[*]Possible fix for client showing wrong player model sometimes[*]Fixed ragdoll follow camera stucking in geometry when i.e. in water[*]Fixed player camera clipping into some geometry during certain actions[*]Fixed FFA mode respawning a player while in a private duel and waiting for a new round to start[/list]

notes.title: Servers down + Patch 1658
notes.notes:
Hey all, we have just patched the game to the latest version. Unfortunately our official servers will be down for the time being, until we can fix it, you can still play on the nightly server which will run on the correct version.

We'll also have patch notes for you soon, thanks for waiting!

notes.title: Longswords Patch 1548
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here's the changelog for patch #1548. Not listed here is a bunch of work done on Steam Workshop integration which Biohazard went over on our [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zGBHWhUkMI&feature=youtu.be]developer hangout[/url], which you can tune into every Saturday at 7pm EST. Supporting the community and letting players implement their own swords is something we care greatly about, so expect this feature soon![b]Longswords[/b] have also gone live this patch! They have lower fast stance and air attack damage, but do double damage when breaking through a parry and hitting someone. Longswords have the Feint ability, which Foils used to have. They also have a higher than average charge time with a lower than average charge run speed, and cannot cancel side attacks into one another.

http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/berimbau-LONGSWORD2.jpg

http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/berimbau-LONGSWORD1.jpg


[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Longsword sword type added, including the following new selectable swords: Tone Death, Grave Requiem, Caduceus Chord, Gaelic Opera[*]Feint now gets boosted run speed from charging[*]Increased Ryoku fast attack tier 1 damage by 2[*]Jian base damage increased from 75% to 85%[*]Judgement: reduced heavy S1 T1 damage from 50 to 40[*]Judgement: reduced heavy S2 T1 damage from 50 to 45[*]Judgement: reduced balanced S2 T1 damage from 28 to 24[*]Can now set what sword a bot is using[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Default items will be available if a players client can't communicate with server[*]Fixed some items being swapped when changing them mid round[*]Fixed player origin not moving to new arena when switching arenas in duel watch mode (causing sounds/particles to not play and other problems)[*]Head turn angle shouldn’t clip into chest as much[*]Charge sound is now client side to make it stop better with high ping and jitter[*]Improved interpolation on remote players[*]Fixed physics props simulating too fast with high ping[*]Screenshake should no longer be amplified with higher ping[*]Fixed opponent moving around during grab with high ping[*]Optimizations for players not being rendered[*]Tick rate should no longer affect tracers[*]Kneel/recovery attack set to balanced stance always so it doesn't have arbitrary behavior for some properties[*]Fixed SDK launcher and hammer default projects to work with Blade Symphony[/list]
[b]Graphics & Sound[/b]
[list][*]Update to district skybox, events play more often[*]Updated district and monastery soundscapes[*]New winter 2D skybox[*]Re-enabled Temple camera clips[*]Fixed Monastery 2v2 spawns for cloister[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1511 Change Log
notes.notes:
Hey all, today we have a bug fix patch and game balance fixes for you. As you may have heard, Longswords were coming. Unfortunately, that's delayed to the next one since the last patch we issued contained a few bugs which required our attention.

As always you can see the changelog on our website:
[url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/07/patch-1511/]http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/07/patch-1511/[/url]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Made charge run bonus apply slightly slower and reduced max speed[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list][*]Judgement heavy left t2 lock-time increased from 0.85 to 1.4 and damage from 48 to 44 and reduced amount of tracers after the attack[*]Judgement heavy right t2 lock-time increased from 1.0 to 1.5 and damage from 48 to 40[*]Ryoku air string 1 t1 reduced damage from 18 to 14[*]Ryoku air string 2 knockback reduced from 1.0 to 0.25[*]Ryoku balanced string 3 t1 damage reduced from 18 to 12 and t2 damage from 22 to 20[*]Ryoku fast left t1 damage increased from 10 to 12[*]Ryoku fast right t1 damage increased from 10 to 12[/list][b]Foil changes:[/b][list][*]Foil now does 90% max damage with heavy stance (from 100%)[*]Foil guard can now block stars[*]Foil guard has increased knockback[/list][b]Jian changes:[/b][list][*]Jian multihit scale increased from 0.25 to 0.35 so that each multi-hit has slightly more damage than previous version[*]Jian air damage now does 50% more damage (after 25% damage reduction it normally has)[/list][b]Scimitar changes:[/b][list][*]Scimitar multihit rate from 0.035 to 0.037 (slightly less multihits)[*]Scimitar min damage per hit is now back to 3 (from 1)[*]Scimitar forward attack damage increased from 15% to 25%[*]Scimitar side attack damage reduced from 36% to 25%[*]Scimitar fast attack damage is now 50% more (after all the other scaling)[/list] 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed getting stuck vaulting or climbing when being hit[*]Prevented players from wall-running props[*]Fixing shadows for attachments not showing[*]Fixed prediction errors at start and end of climb action[*]Fixed sword sound spatialization[*]Attempted to fix a shutdown crash[*]Fixed bots not actually attacking as fast as they could have[*]Fixed tracer parries getting knockback into the wrong direction[*]Fixed air tracer parry knockback pushing you straight up[*]Fixed hitstun in air to not play leg jump animation layer[*]Made client player destroy item entities when it leaves potentially visible sets[/list] 
[b]Sound[/b]
[list][*]Tweaked timings and volume on District ambient sounds[/list] 
[b]Graphics/Mapping[/b]
[list][*]Updated vault animation[*]Added new lighting to District, skybox, fog[*]Fixed wallrun exploit on Duel Winter[*]Players now ragdoll when dying in-air[*]Characters now turn their heads to look at their opponents[*]Fixed some textures on monastery[*]Fixed some spawn points on community[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1491 Change Log
notes.notes:
Hi guys, here's the patch notes for the newest version of Blade Symphony that just went live on Steam, revision #1491. You can also see the patch notes on our site at: [url=https://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/06/blade-symphony-patch-1498-changelog/]https://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/06/blade-symphony-patch-1498-changelog/[/url]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Foil now has “guard” for it’s block tech, a mobile defense that you can walk around that absorbs the first hit of an enemy’s attack[*]Players can now vault over low walls when dashing into them[*]You can now wallrun diagonally and horizontally left and right[*]Added cvar bot_ffa_duel to make bots duel in ffa[*]Players now spawn near one another in ffa when engaged in a duel[*]+walk implemented for fun and profit[/list] 
[b]Balance[/b]
[list][*]Ryoku fast string 1 t1 damage from 20->17 and lock duration from 0.55->0.58[*]Judgement fast left and right t1 lock duration 0.63->0.75[*]Phalanx balanced string 1 t1 damage 24->22[*]Replaced phalanx balanced string 1 t2 animation with identical t1 animation, and made locktime 0.5->0.6[/list][b]Foil changes:[/b][list][*]Made thrust damage use the dot product as a bonus additive multiplier that adds on top of normal scale[*]Foil's damagedotproductx is 1.3 meaning attacks closest to the perfect "thrust" will get up 30% damage bonus (scaling)[*]Foil forward attacks is now 0.5 power[*]Foil side attacks is now 0.6 power[/list][b]scimitar damage scaling changed:[/b][list][*]Scimitar now has block instead of kick (pending new block tech)[*]Scimitar multihit rate 0.0285->0.035 (slightly less multihits)[*]Scimitar has reduced min damage 3->1[*]Scimitar forward attack damage 0.4->0.1[*]Scimitar side attack damage 0.4->0.36[*]These are to compensate the changes from last revision where scimitar no longer has damage scaling (equal damage per hit)[*]Scimitar knockback from 1.0 to 1.05[/list][b]Throwable weapon changes:[/b][list][*]Removed stun from throwable hit and block interrupts[*]Made throwable weapon homing less effective[*]Made it possible to block stars while charging t1[*]Prevented stars from interrupting attacks, players just take damage[*]While charging, players need to face star to block with normal autoblock rules[*]Increased throwable damage to 15[/list] 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed being able to throw a weapon while sheathing[*]Fixed duplicate player names in ffa scoreboard[*]Fixed 2v2 spawning in floor on cloister arena[*]Made players in ffa duels not collide with players in other duels or free roaming ones[/list] 
[b]Sound[/b]
[list][*]Switched away from miles sound system, now use sfml (audio is now in FLAC format)[*]Sword types now have their own sound effects[*]Added glass footstep sounds[*]District soundscape updated[/list] 
[b]Graphics/Mapping[/b]
[list][*]Cleaned up district pipe work, converted to model[*]New animation for jian intercept[*]ffa_community updates including a new arena[*]Implemented capes[*]Adding continuous dust slide particle for when getting pushed back[/list]

notes.title: The 1337+1 Patch (r1338)
notes.notes:
Hi all, Flux here bringing you patch notes today. And while I’m here I want you to know it was my 30th birthday this week!

[url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/05/blade-symphony-13371-patch-changes/]See full patch notes here.[/url]

We’ve been watching players play and reading your feedback constantly. Some things we’ve noticed and are changing:

[list]
[*]Phalanx balanced right is obviously broken. The amount of skill it takes to swing that attack over and over compared to what it takes to stop that strategy was disproportionate. We've toned it down a notch, without taking out thrill of using it in a combo. We’ll keep an eye on things like this when the patch gets in your hands.
[*]Grab itself does a lot of damage, but by itself isn’t very interesting when it’s just a one click damage dealer. The interesting part is the followup when the opponent is on the ground. We’re still not totally happy with it the entire grab and throw sequence, but this change should make it less of a match-deciding factor.
[*]The Scimitar was also giving out disproportionate amounts of damage and has been reduced from 50% damage output to 40%. This makes the the Scimitar rely more on multi-hits and less on attack damage itself. The scimitar is pretty incomplete since it lacks a good defensive tech which we’re still working on.
[*]We've noticed that Tier2 and Tier3s are often eschewed by quick swipes of Tier1. We've boosted the damages of many Tier2 and Tier3 moves accordingly to make them more attractive options when fighting. Hopefully this will encourage more players to try charging attacks as well as using them to chase down opponents.
[*]Similar to charged attacks, air attacks are often used by mistake since their damage output compared to the risk of using them is not balanced out. We've increased the damage to many air side attacks to make them more attractive.
[*]Some forward attacks are far outshined by their side attack counterparts. We've increased the damage for certain forward attacks that have more attractive side attacks by making the forward ones more attractive. Specifically moves that aren’t used as often, such as Judgement’s fast forward strings and heavy strings.
[*]Ryoku was and still is extremely lacking in options. We’re experimenting with some new attacks for him. See below.
[/list]

Keep in mind we’re still painting with a pretty broad brush right now and not really settling in the super minute game balances because there are still quite a few moving parts. These changes are to shift the overall balance of power and attempt to reward skillful gameplay, and we’re still homing in on them so there’s going to be some changes that seem pretty huge. Compared to two months ago these changes are quite mild.

notes.title: Patch 1308
notes.notes:
Hard at work to bring you juicy combat.

[url=https://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/05/blade-symphony-beta-update-quick-balance-patch/]Your patch notes here.[/url]

Changelog for version 0.01.01308 

[b]Ryoku[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced tracer amount for fast stance
[*]Gave fast stance some breaks in-between
[*]increased lock duration for Ryoku fast 1 t1 from 0.24s to 0.32s
[*]increased lock duration for Ryoku fast 2 t1 from 0.28s to 0.30s
[*]increased lock duration for Ryoku fast 3 t1 from 0.28s to 0.50s
[*]increased lock duration for Ryoku fast 5 t1 from 0.26s to 0.80s
[*]increased lock duration for Ryoku fast 6 t1 from 1.40s to 1.60s
[*]Very slightly slowed heavy forward
 [/list]

[b]Phalanx[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced damage for Balanced side (from 24 to 20)
[*]Increased lock duration for Balanced Right T1 (from 0.85s to 0.95s)
[*]Increased damage for fast stance
[*]Increased damage for Phalanx fast 1 (t1: 10 -> 12, t2: 12 -> 14, t3: 16 -> 18)
[*]Increased damage for Phalanx fast 2 (t1: 10 -> 12, t2: 12 -> 14, t3: 16 -> 18)
[*]Increased damage for Phalanx fast 3 (t1: 5 -> 16, t2: 6 -> 18, t3: 10 -> 22)
[*]Increased damage for Phalanx fast 4 (t2: 12 -> 18, t3: 16 -> 25)
[*]Increased cooldown for Phalanx fast 3 and 4
[*]Increased lock duration for Phalanx fast 3 (t1: 0.4s -> 0.6s, t2: 0.65s -> 0.7s)
[*]increased lock duration for Phalanx fast 4 t1 from 0.7s to 0.85s
 [/list] 

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Made side attacks add to string counter once again
[*]Made side attack cancels only work when string counter is not maxed out
[*]This means Phalanx can chain two balanced side attacks but the third will come out at regular timings (non canceled)
[*]This also means Phalanx can switch to fast stance and chain two fast side attacks if he wants
[*]This means Phalanx can only chain from a single side heavy down to lesser stances, etc.
[*]Reduced damage of throwing weapon from 20 to 15
[*]Decreased Tier 2 time from 1.25 seconds to 1.0 seconds
[*]Patching an issue with cooldown timers from actions like feint and block overriding dash cooldown
[*]Increased lag compensation distance
[*]Made players stop kneeling when hit
[*]Disabled throwing star homing in pure FFA (non private duel or team duel)
[*]Fixing input buffering for attack cancel
[*]Slightly tweaked tracer parry hitbox
 [/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixing issues where the run upper body animation will keep playing when [*]running against a wall
[*]Improved camera clips on Winter
[*]Made the flame song sword more metallic looking
[*]Fixed disappearing structures in District
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Prevented chat history from fading out
[*]Added vote kick option
[*]Fixed chat history clearing
 [/list]

[*]This also means Phalanx can switch to fast stance and chain two fast side attacks if he wants
[*]This means Phalanx can only chain from a single side heavy down to lesser stances, etc.
[*]Reduced damage of throwing weapon from 20 to 15
[*]Decreased Tier 2 time from 1.25 seconds to 1.0 seconds
[*]Patching an issue with cooldown timers from actions like feint and block overriding dash cooldown
[*]Increased lag compensation distance
[*]Made players stop kneeling when hit
[*]Disabled throwing star homing in pure FFA (non private duel or team duel)
[*]Fixing input buffering for attack cancel
[*]Slightly tweaked tracer parry hitbox
 [/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixing issues where the run upper body animation will keep playing when [*]running against a wall
[*]Improved camera clips on Winter
[*]Made the flame song sword more metallic looking
[*]Fixed disappearing structures in District
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Prevented chat history from fading out
[*]Added vote kick option
[*]Fixed chat history clearing
 [/list]

notes.title: The "Running with Scissors" Patch 1286
notes.notes:
[h1]Breaking Note: We're aware there is a current screwup with some (lots) of our servers not being joinable, it only currently affects linux servers (as far as we can tell) and are working on fixing it asap, sorry guys[/h1]

[url=http://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/05/blade-symphony-beta-update-running-with-scissors/]Your patch notes here.[/url]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Added experimental upper body only attack for judgement heavy left and right and Phalanx balanced left and right T1
[*]Added experimental left/right attack canceling. When using side attacks, you can now cancel half of the current attack by attacking in the opposite direction.
[*]You can no longer dash right after attacking. Attacking will effectively use up your dash cooldown
[*]Air attacks now beat heavy stance in parries (but still lose to everything else).
[*]Combo pushback amount increased back to before last patch.
[*]Made air stun turns the player according to knockback direction.
[*]Juggling is now possible again.
[*]Made roll/shuffle reset turn rates so their movement feels less weird.
[*]Made mirrored grabs cause deflection rather than stun/interrupt. Added a new animation for this.
[*]Reduced penalty for sword clash vs world.
[*]Turn penalty on hit is reduced.
[*]Made soft collision during attacks stronger so players shouldn’t clip into each other as much
 [/list]

[b]Phalanx[/b]
[list]
[*]Slowing down Phalanx Balanced Right attacks slightly.
[*]Slowing down Phalanx Balanced Left T2.
[*]Replaced Phalanx Balanced Left T1 and Right T1 with moveable attacks.
[*]Slowing down Phalanx Heavy Left and Right T2 and T3 to reflect the ability to cancel side attacks.
[/list] 

[b]Ryoku[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced knockback for Ryoku Fast 3, 4, 5.
[*]Slightly increased locktime for Ryoku Fast 6
[*]Reduced startup time and speed for Ryoku Balanced Left Tier 1 and Balanced [*]String 1 T1
[*]Reduced lock time for Ryoku Air Left T1 and Right T1
[/list] 

[b]Judgement[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaced Judgement Heavy Left T1 and Right t1 with moveable attacks.
[*]Adjusted these damages and lock times accordingly (damage from 40 to 30).
[*]Slowed startup time for Judgement Balanced Left T1.
[*]Slowed startup time for Judgement Balanced Forward T1.
 [/list]

[b]Katana[/b]
[list]
[*]Katana now takes chip damage on block (1 health per hit).
[/list] 

[b]Throwable Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*]Made throwables cancelable if throw star button is not held. They have a minimum cancel time as well.
[*]Throwable weapons have no effect on players who charge to Tier 2 or above.
 [/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]New particle for blocking
[*]Improved tracer visuals for landed attacks (matches up better now)
[*]Improved neutral hit reaction stumble walk.
[/list] 

[b]Global[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now callvote and affect duel type per arena (1v1, 2v2, 2v1)
[*]Duel type is now visible on scoreboard
[*]Added a vote menu from Play Online sub menu
[*]Added a vote yes and vote no binding (you should bind it from options)
[*]When timer runs out the player with more health wins.
 [/list]

[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue players getting stuck on Winter Deck arena.
[*]ffa_community updated.
[*]Adjusted overall volume and balance of ambient sounds on District.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1240
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1240 (5/4/2013)[/h1]

Hey all, we've done some gameplay balances as well as animation updates. Here are your patch notes:

[list]
[*]Thrown weapons should no longer have their sound loop after disappearing
[*]Improve interpolation amount being calculated wrong on listen servers for local player
[*]Prevented throw weapon action when kneeling
[*]Increased throw weapon delay from 0.5 to 0.55
[*]Changed Ryoku heavy left not to have pull (negative knockback) to prevent infinite combo
[*]Added stumble anims to fast/balanced attacks
[*]Added vote system to server (disabled by default), currently has kick vote
[*]Reduced combo push
[*]Ryoku balanced 1 and left 1, made them a bit slower and reduced range
[*]Updated ffa_community map build with preliminary textures/models/layout changes
[*]You can now move while in hitstun
[*]Air juggling no longer works as a side effect, we’ll look into bring it back
[/list]
